test_title: PYST 17: SSC CHSL - English (Held On: 8 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the highlighted word.**

His action doesn’t **warrant **such a punishment.
solution: The correct answer is '**Breach**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate word **antonym** of the given word '**warrant**' is '**breach**'. • **Warrant**: an official written statement that gives somebody permission to do something. [(किसी काम को करने की) आधिकारिक अनुमति; वॉरंट, अधिपत्र, आज्ञापत्र] • *Example: a search **warrant** [a document that allows the police to search a house]...* • **Breach**: an act that breaks an agreement, a law, etc. (नियम, समझौते की शर्तों आदि का उल्‍लंघन; नियम-भंग) • *Example: a **breach** of confidence...* **Correct Answer:__** *Breach.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **triumph**: a great success or victory; the feeling of happiness that you have because of this. (महान सफलता या विजय; सफलता या विजय का उल्‍लास) • **support**: to help somebody by saying that you agree with him/her/it, and sometimes giving practical help such as money. [किसी को (सहमति के आधार पर) समर्थन देना या किसी की (धन देकर) सहायता करना] • **captivate**: to attract and hold somebody’s attention. (किसी का ध्यान आकृष्‍ट रखना; मोहित कर देना) 33:Tcbd, The solution is** When Reema saw her mother, she was in ecstasy.**
